def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    markers=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for i,(r,c) in enumerate(markers):
        for rr,cc in markers[i+1:]:
            if r==rr:
                for x in range(min(c,cc)+1,max(c,cc)): out[r][x]=3
            elif c==cc:
                for y in range(min(r,rr)+1,max(r,rr)): out[y][c]=3
    return out
PY
